js: // The scene is read once while everything works: the point is that failures afterwards do not blank what is known.
const out = { baseline, minCards: 999, minTiles: 999, falseNobody: 0, minLineup: 999, emptySelect: 0, samples: 0 };
if (views[i % 4] === 'scene') { out.minTiles = Math.min(out.minTiles, document.querySelectorAll('#active-list .tile').length); if (document.querySelector('.scene-empty')) out.falseNobody++; }
const sel = document.querySelector('.bind select'); if (sel && (sel.value === '' || !sel.value)) out.emptySelect++;
// chaos off: everything must settle to the full, correct state
out.stagesWithPicture = stages.filter(s => { const i = s.querySelector('img'); return i && i.style.display !== 'none' && i.naturalWidth > 0; }).length;
